statement.text:
The group of virtual pure braids V Pn , n ⩾ 2, is generated by elements λij ,
1 ⩽ i ̸= j ⩽ n, and is defined by the relations λij λkl = λkl λij , λki λkj λij = λij λkj λki ,
where different letters denote different indices.
   a) Construct a normal form of words in the group V Pn for n ⩾ 4.
   b) Is the group V Pn linear for n ⩾ 4? It is known that the group V P3 is linear.
                                                                              V. G. Bardakov
